title: Pix refund status changed
description:
A Pix reversal (refund) status change event. The following endpoints generate this event: Create refund request, Cancel refund, and Close refund. For more information, see the Pix instant payments guide. Also see the Pix payments data events guide.

The Special Return Mechanism - Mecanismo Especial de Devolução (MED) - the Pix refund mechanism, is responsible for this event.

contested_participant.title: Contested participant

creation_date_time.title: Creation date time

requesting_participant.title: Requesting participant
requesting_participant.description: Requesting participant's ISPB (Identifcador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil) - the Brazilian Payment System identifier, an 8-digit value.

correlation_id.title: Correlation Id
correlation_id.description: The correlation ID (CID) field is used to link related API requests and events. The CID can help the Pismo engineering team track everything related to a call. You can find the CID field in the response header from an API endpoint call.

refund_transaction_id.title: Refund transaction ID

fund_recovery_id.title: Fund recovery ID
fund_recovery_id.description: Fund recovery transaction end-to-end ID (full or partial).

tax_id_number.title: Pix provider's document number
tax_id_number.description: Federal document number of the Pix provider. This may be a government-issued identifier, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas (CPF) number (Brazil). Must be numeric and contain between 11 and 14 digits.

monitor_account.title: Monitor account

effective_refunded_amount.title: Effective refunded amount
effective_refunded_amount.description: Actual amount refunded to the user.
